name: Tick Saver
description: Frame-saver / input buffer. Press F6 to cycle the tick save (off, 1, 2, 4, 8 ticks).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for the tick saver. F6 changes the tick amount.

buffer-press.name: Buffer early presses
buffer-press.description: A press made up to N ticks before it can be used (landing, touching an orb) is held and applied when it becomes usable.

buffer-orbs.name: Include orbs
buffer-orbs.description: Early presses also trigger an orb you touch within N ticks.

buffer-ground.name: Include ground jumps
buffer-ground.description: Early presses also jump on landing within N ticks (cube, ball, robot, spider).

extend-hold.name: Extend holds
extend-hold.description: Delays every release by N ticks, and cancels the release if you press again in that time. Makes the game feel delayed on releases, so it is off by default.

show-overlay.name: Show overlay
show-overlay.description: Show the current tick save and how many ticks were used.
